provider: NOAA NCEI through NOAA Open Data Dissemination (NODD)
api_version: GHCN-Daily rolling 3.x; single-station provider-native CSV byte-range observation sample

request_contract.parameter_rules: One fixed public HTTPS GET to /csv/by_station/USW00094728.csv for GHCN station USW00094728 (New York Central Park); send only Range: bytes=0-65535 and Accept: text/csv, with no redirects, retries, query, caller-supplied host, station, filename, headers or sample expansion. Accept only HTTP 206 with Content-Range bytes 0-65535/TOTAL for TOTAL>65536 and exactly 65536 returned bytes. Parse only complete CSV lines in this prefix; discard incomplete trailing line and never treat sample as complete annual/station history. No external data bytes persisted, no provider observations printed, no source/model admission.

response_contract.format: First 65536 original bytes of one station-scoped GHCN-Daily provider-native CSV. Strict 8-column ID,DATE,ELEMENT,DATA_VALUE,M_FLAG,Q_FLAG,S_FLAG,OBS_TIME records, possible CSV header; this is only a byte-range sample.
response_contract.scientific_semantics: Individual daily station ELEMENT values use NOAA element-specific units and represent local observation semantics, not event losses, calibrated catastrophe intensities or insured locations. Measurement, quality and source flags are essential; blank Q_FLAG does not prove scientific fitness or representativeness. The prefix begins at the earliest provider records and is not a representative or recent climate sample. Central Park observations cannot be inferred to describe New York exposure, insurer portfolios or catastrophe return periods. Exact station identity is needed as a research canary only.

operational_constraints.rate_limit_notes: Only one fixed anonymous range request, no bulk collection, pagination, retries or hourly automation; source data bytes are transient and never committed or inserted into Neon.
operational_constraints.mutability_notes: GHCN-Daily is rolling and may be reprocessed. Report UTC retrieval time, requested byte range, total source size, SHA-256 of the returned 65536-byte prefix and parser-script SHA-256. Hash of a prefix is NOT the checksum of the full original file; pin the GHCN version separately when building a model.

rights_and_policy.notes: The NOAA NODD data registry expressly labels distributed GHCN Daily as CC0-1.0 with no use restrictions, attribution requested and no implication of NOAA endorsement. This specific single-station, 64-KiB range sample is compatible with public anonymous download. The NOAA-origin distribution rights do not warrant data completeness, source-agency homogeneity or scientific/model fitness, and do not justify unreviewed scraping of other providers.

expected_evidence: One exact HTTPS 206 for fixed station CSV and Content-Range bytes 0-65535/TOTAL, no redirects
Exactly 65536 original prefix bytes and SHA-256; strict UTF-8, strict station identity and eight original CSV fields
Bounded row count and measurement/source/quality flag coverage in small metadata-only receipt; no raw weather values printed or stored
UTC retrieval, provider rolling sample qualification, code SHA and all scientific/model admission flags false

notes: Prior NODD version/country metadata source-access contract is separate and already merged; this pilot attempts real original weather-observation CSV bytes only in a tightly bounded, read-only Range request. The fixed station path is defined by NOAA public NODD station distribution documentation; no claim of a successful exact range request is made before hosted run evidence.
